_notes.canonical_owner_repo: This is the central upstream-template-identity vs destination-namespace case. The playlist cites the pre-rename destination namespace All-Hands-AI/OpenHands; the organisation was renamed and the repository now lives at OpenHands/OpenHands (repo id 771302083, owner org id 225919603). Both facts hold at once: the cited path is still a valid entry point that GitHub redirects, while the canonical identity is OpenHands/OpenHands. The cited path is recorded only in source_identifier / original_url_from_playlist; the canonical identity is additive, never a rewrite. The legacy org All-Hands-AI (org id 169105795) still exists but no longer hosts this repository.
_notes.redirect_proof: A live contents probe on the cited path returned 200 OK while url, html_url, download_url and git_url in the response body were all rooted at OpenHands/OpenHands (README blob sha dca34f6ffb88f397a635e1cedd78601747d1ecda).
_notes.description: github_api_live wins over the target_set_csv paraphrase (which embedded an unverified SWE-Bench score and a redirect note) and over readme_opening. The published string is the live owner-set value including the leading U+1F64C character; the 2026-04 reviewed winner had that character stripped and is withheld.
_notes.license: target_set_csv claimed MIT and the 2026-04 github_api_live pass reported no SPDX assertion. On the live gate GitHub's detector reports license.key=mit / license.spdx_id=MIT / license.name=MIT License, so MIT is published on the authority of the live github_api_live tier - the tier order is unchanged, only the snapshot moved.
_notes.readme_drift: The live README now opens on the 'Agent Canvas' heading, no longer 'OpenHands: AI-Driven Development'. readme_opening was already a discarded tier-2 candidate for description, so no finalized value moves.
